pin.terms:
Website Link - https://www.omantel.om/en/personal/mobile-prepaid

General:

All Plans are 5% VAT inclusive.
 
New Hayyak plans are available for both new and existing prepaid customers.
 
Free Passes can be availed at any time during the validity of the plan: 
 
Roaming Pass 1: Applicable in GCC on Hayyak-21, Hayyak-16, Hayyak-13 and Hayyak-11. 
 
Social Pass 1: Applicable for WhatsApp, X, Facebook, Snapchat, and Instagram on Hayyak-21, Hayyak-16, and Hayyak-13.
 
 Social Pass 2: Applicable for WhatsApp, X, Facebook, Snapchat, Instagram, and YouTube on Hayyak-11, Hayyak-8, and Hayyak-5.
 
Data Rollover: Customers can roll over unused data and minutes to the next month by re-subscribing to the same plan within 3 days of expiry.
 
Subscribing to a new Hayyak plan within the validity period will not result in the loss of remaining data and voice minutes from the existing plan.
 
Voice Flexi minutes are applicable for local calls and international calls to Bangladesh, India, and Pakistan.
 
New Hayyak plans support local Voice over Wi-Fi at no extra charge.
 
Data usage is local only and not applicable while roaming.
 
Upon exceeding the allocated voice minutes, pay-as-you-go (PAYG) tariffs will apply (National rate: 44 Bz/min).
 
Upon exceeding the allocated voice minutes, pay-as-you-go (PAYG) tariffs will apply (National rate: 44 Bz/min). Upon expiry of the plan, extra usage charges will apply (PAYG national rate: 51.2 Bz/MB).
 
PAYG national SMS tariff applies at 10 Bz/SMS.
